features.name: Genie's Wrath / Elemental Vessel
features.desc: With Channel Divinity, you imbue your strikes with elemental damage (Fire, Cold, Thunder, or Lightning) or take refuge in an elemental vessel.

features.name: Genie's Aura
features.desc: You and allies within 10 feet gain Resistance to a chosen elemental damage type.

features.name: Elemental Smite
features.desc: Once per turn, your elemental damage ignores Resistance and deals an extra die.

features.name: Genie's Splendor
features.desc: As an action, for 1 minute, you hover (Fly Speed), grow in size, and deal elemental damage to enemies around you.
